reason: The hand-typing grind is real and I'd love my hours back, but I'm not putting a card down for a tool with no customer results and my own Instagram account on the line. Three days isn't enough to see whether any of these DMs turn into replies, and after day 3 it's $147 and final.
objection: Zero published results, and it sends from my own Instagram. If the DMs read generic or the account gets flagged, I've lost the account and $147 with no refund, and I can't tell in 3 days whether it works.
would_change_my_mind: A few real agency owners showing actual reply and booked-call numbers from it, plus a trial long enough (a week or more) to get real replies before the card is charged, or a refund if it doesn't book a call.
